title: ViewConfigPanel: split pageConfig into 5 sections, eye-toggle field selector, tab gear icon & panel animation
body:
The `pageConfig` section mixed 18+ fields (toolbar toggles, navigation, export, selection, record creation) into a single block, making it hard for users to locate settings. Field selector used checkboxes instead of Airtable-style eye toggles and lacked search/batch operations. View tabs had no direct config panel access, and the panel lacked slide animation.

### Section restructure

Split `pageConfig` into 5 focused sections:

- **General** — label, description, view type (non-collapsible)
- **Toolbar** — 7 toggle switches for search/sort/filter/group/color/density
- **Navigation** — mode, drawer width, new tab
- **Records** — selection mode, add record sub-editor
- **Export & Print** — export config, record count, printing (`defaultCollapsed: true`)

```ts
// Before: 1 section with 18 fields
sections: [buildPageConfigSection(...), buildDataSection(...), ...]

// After: 5 sections, ordered by usage frequency
sections: [
  buildGeneralSection(...),
  buildToolbarSection(...),
  buildNavigationSection(...),
  buildRecordsSection(...),
  buildExportPrintSection(...),
  buildDataSection(...),
  ...
]
```

### Field selector upgrade

- Eye/eye-off button toggles replace checkboxes (`col-eye-{name}`)
- Search input filters fields by name
- Show All / Hide All batch buttons
- Grip handles for visual drag affordance

### View tab gear icon & panel linkage

- Added `onConfigView` prop to `ViewTabBar` with a Settings2 gear icon on the active tab
- Clicking the gear icon opens the ViewConfigPanel for that specific view
- Panel auto-syncs content on view tab switch (draft resets via `stableKey = activeView.id`)

### Panel slide animation

- CSS `transition-[max-width,opacity] duration-300 ease-in-out` wraps the ViewConfigPanel for smooth slide-in/slide-out

### i18n

13 new keys added to all 11 locales (en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, ru, pt, ko, ar).

### Tests

- Schema tests: 110 passing (+7 new for section structure)
- ViewConfigPanel tests: 139 passing (+3 new for search/Show All/Hide All)
- ViewTabBar tests: 49 passing (+5 new for gear icon)
- ObjectView tests: 31 passing (section expansion for collapsed exportPrint)
- Broader suite: 899 passing, 4 pre-existing ObjectForm failures unrelated
